plan.explanation: Face milling of datum face F1 is performed first on M2 to establish orientation. Subsequent operations are allocated: hole features (F2, F6, F7) use spot drilling and drilling on M1; reaming for F6 follows drilling on M1. Pocket feature F3 is machined on M2 after the datum. Threaded holes F4 and F5 require drilling followed by tapping on M1. All precedence constraints regarding datum dependency and internal hole sequence are respected.
assumptions: Tool changes between operations of different types or tools on the same machine are assumed instantaneous.
Part handling/setup time is included in duration estimates or ignored as per rough estimation rule.
uncertainties: Exact drill sizes for T6 and T1 are not specified; they are assumed compatible with hole diameters required by feature specifications.
Tool diameter compatibility for specific hole diameters (e.g., 6.0mm, 8.0mm) is assumed to exist within the tool inventory.
